title: Fourier bias criterion for the support density
statement: Let $m$ be a positive natural number and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$. The support density is $\varepsilon$-biased, meaning that every nonzero binary frequency has Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most $\varepsilon$, if and only if $\varepsilon$ is at least $\dfrac{2^{-m}}{1-2^{-m}}$.
